First build for Fallout 4 **Next-Gen (runtime 1.10.984)**.

## Requirements

- Fallout 4 1.10.984
- F4SE 0.7.2
- Address Library for F4SE Plugins (1.10.984)

## Install

Install `CustomMeshesPathF4-v2.0.0.zip` with your mod manager, or copy the contents of its `F4SE\Plugins` folder into `Data\F4SE\Plugins`. `CustomMeshesPathF4.dll` is also attached on its own for updating an existing install.

Existing `CustomMeshesPathF4_Rules.txt` files work unchanged. For the old-gen game (1.10.163), keep using the build in `legacy/1.10.163` in the repository.

## Changes

- Rebuilt for F4SE 0.7.2 and runtime 1.10.984.
- Now requires Address Library for F4SE Plugins.
- When the game starts, the plugin checks the game functions it hooks. If a check fails, it disables itself and explains why in `Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\CustomMeshesPathF4.log`, instead of patching the wrong code.
- A `#` comment after a rule no longer breaks that rule.
- An invalid form ID in the rules file is logged instead of crashing the game.
- Smaller fixes: reloading the rules is safe while meshes load on other threads, an actor keeps its custom paths if another actor is loaded in the middle of it, and replacing the body-morph (`BODYTRI`) path no longer leaks the old string.

## Known limitations

- This build was tested outside the game but has not yet been confirmed in-game. If the log says the hooks could not be installed, please open an issue with the log attached.
- Only loose files are used as replacements; meshes packed in `.ba2` archives are not detected.
